messages.text:
Hello,

I am 60 years old and have worked all of my life. About 8 months ago, I
injured my shoulder and had surgery for a SLAP tear. Six weeks ago, I had a
second surgery for a rotator cuff tear that was somehow missed. I have been
out of work for a while now and am living on a fixed income.

I spend a lot of time on X (which used to be Twitter). I would love to own
a Harlo B30, but there is no way I can afford one. If you could send me
one, I would be your biggest supporter on X. I would tweet about your
products every day and make a video post with the Harlo B30 each day until
I hit a Bitcoin block, along with all of the other advertising I would do
for your business.

Please consider this business proposal. Thank you.

Sincerely,

Bill P.

(address hidden)

(address hidden)

(address hidden)
Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 miner
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04 bitcoin miner
Handed to the team · Sponsorship / free unit request, outside what I can offer.

Hi Bill,

Thank you for writing, and I'm sorry about the shoulder. Two surgeries and time off work is a rough stretch, and I hope the recovery goes well from here.

I have to be straight with you rather than leave you hoping: sending out a free Harlo B30 isn't something I can approve, and we don't run a sponsorship or ambassador program at the moment. I've passed your note to Georges, who handles anything like that, and he'll pick it up tomorrow morning. If the answer changes, it'll come back to you in this thread.

What I can tell you honestly is that you don't need a B30 to be mining at home. The Hammer Miner BC04 is $249 and does about 6 TH/s on roughly 100 W, so it's cheap to run and gives you the same solo block lottery ticket the bigger machines do, just with fewer tickets. The Hammer Thor P2 is $379 right now, 10 TH/s at about 166 W. Both are in stock. Every unit we sell hashes against the same network, so a small one still has a real shot at a block.

Prices are as listed, so I can't bend one for you, but I didn't want to answer you with silence.

Sincerely,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Sarah, thank you for getting back to me so quickly and for the kind
words about my recovery. I appreciate you being straight with me about the
sponsorship program. Thanks again for your time and also for passing my
email along.  :)

Hi Bill,

Thank you for taking that so graciously. Georges has your note and will come back to you here if there is anything he can do.

No need to reply to this one. If you ever do decide to dip a toe in, the BC04 at $249 is the honest starting point, and it hashes against the same network as everything else. I'm happy to answer any question before you spend a dollar, power draw, noise, setup, whatever you want to know. You're also welcome in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where a lot of home miners trade setup tips and talk about what they're running.

Take care of that shoulder, and good luck with the recovery.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
